title: RuneScape Dragonwilds Tips and Tricks for New Players (1.0 Guide)
author: Caffeinated Replays
description:
New to Runescape Dragonwilds? This guide helps you navigate the large world so you can stop feeling lost and start playing.

Starting a new adventure often leaves you feeling overwhelmed by the sheer scale of the map. I am breaking down the essential starting actions to help you get your bearings, whether you are trying to figure out which quests to prioritize or how to manage your resources effectively.

We also cover how to handle your gear and base building to avoid common mistakes that slow down your progress. Following this beginner guide ensures you spend less time confused and more time enjoying the survival tips that make the early game much smoother for every new player.

0:00 Welcome to Runescape
0:27 This is Important!
0:59 Stay Local
1:40 Early Fast Travel
2:44 Choose Your Style
4:08 Slow The Grind
5:10 Skills as You Explore
6:11 Manage Your Base!
7:17 Mistakes That Cost Time
